meta.themes: Frontier Model Governance, AI Cloud Economics, Scientific AI Workbenches, Developer Agent Tooling

news.title: U.S. government neared voluntary AI model release standards with major labs
news.summary: Reuters reported that Washington is in advanced talks with OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others to set voluntary benchmarks, review timelines, and access rules for frontier model releases, with an announcement possible as early as the following week.

news.title: Anthropic proposed an industry-wide cyber jailbreak severity framework
news.summary: Anthropic published a draft Cyber Jailbreak Severity scale co-developed with Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and other Glasswing partners to standardize how labs score and report frontier-model jailbreak risks.

news.title: OpenAI reportedly halved guest-tier inference costs with software alone
news.summary: The Information reported that OpenAI engineers cut serving costs for logged-out ChatGPT traffic by more than half using software optimizations, reducing the GPUs needed for that tier to a couple hundred.

news.title: GitHub Copilot CLI can run in Actions without a personal access token
news.summary: GitHub said Copilot CLI workflows can authenticate with the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN and bill AI credits directly to the organization, removing the need to store long-lived PATs for CI automations.

news.title: Anthropic restored Claude Fable 5 globally after export controls lifted
news.summary: Anthropic began redeploying Claude Fable 5 worldwide across Claude.ai, Claude Code, and the API after the Commerce Department lifted June 12 export controls, with usage capped at 50% of weekly limits through July 7.

news.title: Together AI raised $800 million at an $8.3 billion valuation
news.summary: Together AI closed an Aramco Ventures-led Series C to expand its open-source AI neocloud, reporting more than $1.15 billion in annual bookings as customers shift production workloads to cheaper open models.

news.title: Meta explored renting excess AI compute and hosted models to businesses
news.summary: Bloomberg reported that Meta is developing a cloud business under Meta Compute to monetize spare AI infrastructure through raw GPU rentals and API access to hosted models such as Muse Spark.

news.title: GitHub Copilot browser tools reached general availability in VS Code
news.summary: GitHub said Copilot agents can now drive the integrated browser in VS Code Stable, navigating live web apps with per-session tab isolation, explicit sharing controls, and enterprise domain allowlists.

news.title: OpenAI introduced GeneBench-Pro for computational biology agents
news.summary: OpenAI released GeneBench-Pro, a research-level benchmark of 129 judgment-heavy biology tasks where GPT-5.6 Sol reached a 28.7% pass rate, up from below 5% on the earlier GeneBench suite.

news.title: Anthropic launched Claude Science, an AI workbench for researchers
news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Science in beta for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users, bundling 60-plus scientific skills, auditable artifacts, and flexible local or HPC compute access into one research environment.

news.title: Etched reported $1 billion in orders for its inference chip systems
news.summary: AI chip startup Etched said TSMC-manufactured silicon is in customer testing and that it has booked $1 billion in frontier inference cluster orders after closing a $500 million round at a $5 billion valuation.

news.title: Google kept Gemini 3.5 Pro on a July launch track as rivals faced restrictions
news.summary: With Fable 5 still offline and GPT-5.6 limited to vetted partners, reports said Gemini 3.5 Pro remained slated for July general availability after missing its June target while Google refined token efficiency and agent performance.
